scope: Evidence-return law: W4 finding/proposal admission, O1 candidate projection separation, consequence non-escalation, targeted evidence-only cross-lane consequence projection, v1 non-live guard.

amendments.authority: R1 F6 reconciliation before R4 implementation admission
amendments.cause: The initial R4 freeze proved consequence-finding schema closure and non-escalation but omitted R1 F6’s positive requirement that a lawful consequence finding reach its affected lane as evidence. The law was incomplete relative to its frozen predecessor, not wrong in what it asserted.
amendments.changed: Added R4-E9 targeted evidence-only lane projection, its reference projection, synthetic delivery substrate, and DC-E9 defeat candidate.
amendments.unchanged: R4-E1 through R4-E8, W4/O1 authority boundaries, finding/proposal payload schemas, admission window, v1 reachability law, and all runtime implementation files.

amendments.authority: Founder direction: commit the session-local E9 discrimination probe as standing defeat candidates
amendments.cause: Amendment 1 recorded one E9 defeat candidate (no projection). R4-E9 already rejected wrong-lane, broadcast, authority-carrying and ordinary-finding projection, but only a one-session disposable probe witnessed it. A weakening of R4-E9 to 'something was sent' would have kept the recorded matrix green. Demonstrated: under that weakening DC-E9b..e SURVIVE while DC-E9 is still killed.
amendments.changed: Added defeat candidates DC-E9b (wrong lane), DC-E9c (broadcast '*'), DC-E9d (authority field beside evidence), DC-E9e (ordinary finding projected cross-lane). Only candidates.mjs changed.
amendments.unchanged: Laws R4-E1 through R4-E9, contract.mjs, substrate.mjs, reference.mjs, falsifiers.mjs, and every runtime implementation file.
